    *   *Revised `PaymentSplitter`:*
        ```java
        public List<BigDecimal> calculateShares(BigDecimal total, int payeeCount) {
            long totalCents = total.movePointRight(2).longValue();
            long shareCents = totalCents / payeeCount;
            long remainderCents = totalCents % payeeCount;
            List<BigDecimal> shares = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < payeeCount; i++) {
                long cents = shareCents + (i < remainderCents ? 1 : 0);
                shares.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(cents, 2));
            }
            return shares;
        }
        ```

    ```java
    public static BigDecimal parse(String amount) {
        if (amount == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID AMOUNT");
        }
        BigDecimal d;
        try {
            d = new BigDecimal(amount.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID AMOUNT: " + amount);
        }
        if (d.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID AMOUNT: " + amount);
        }
        return d.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
    ```
